[quote=dhornaper;60458825][B][i][u]Dhornaper News Network[/u][/i][/b]

(Two days after the attempted assassinstion.)

An emergency vote was initiated by the Senate to enact an amendment to the Constitution granting the Senate powers to expand Presidential authority in emergencies.

The amendment passed the House of Representatives 150 - 20.

Following its passage the Senate unanimously agreed to give the President emergency powers to uphold law and order and safety and the security of the state.[/quote]

[b]A Month Later[/b]

In the aftermath of the assassination attempt, the police and Directorate of Intelligence conducted a thorough investigation. They followed the trajectory of the missed bullet which was lodged into an exterior wall on a nearby warehouse. From the warehouse, the followed it to the impact on the ground near where the President stood. From there, they located the shooter's position, in an abandoned building nearby.

Although there was no gun at the site, they did find gunpowder residue and collected as many fingerprints and loose hairs as they could. After this, the Directorate of Intelligence rounded up 25 people suspected to be involved due to previous intelligence, even if the intelligence was flimsy. Using the fingerprints and DNA samples, they found a few matches among their suspects and previous arrests, all of whom were interrogated thoroughly for hours on end without break until they gave lists of names.

This was repeated through the month until 130 people were arrested. Although Intelligence now knows the name of the shooter from their interrogations and the gun from the bullet, they were not able to locate either. Nevertheless, all 130 remained imprisoned until they were tried swiftly in private emergency tribunals. These tribunals lasted, at most, an hour, with multiple defendants tried together without representation or even being allowed to speak in their defence. All those arrested were convicted. Nine were sentenced to death while the remaining 121 were sentenced to imprisonment ranging from 20 years to life. The executions are scheduled to happen in a few weeks.

Small scale public protests did occur in opposition to the expansion of Presidential authority, primarily from student groups and followers of the since outlawed old political parties. The police dispersed these with batons and arrests while Internal Affairs Ministry had the ringleaders expelled from their universities, blacklisted from future education, confiscated their passports, froze their bank accounts pending criminal investigations, and gave them gag orders prohibiting further protests, public appearances, or publicly speaking. Publications and news agencies seen to be less than enthusiastic about supporting the new laws were also paid a visit by Internal Affairs Minister Muhammad Al-Mansoor.

[spoiler=Operation Julong]

[b]Operation Julong[/b]

With Daesunic forces having committed genocide in the Southern Islands, 3rd and 4th Maneuver Armies would have very little doubt as to the Argossians' desperation, and so would welcome their decision to join the fold. David Cyriacus, still holding point in the north, would move down together with Sanguinian troops to meet with the Kuhaw-Astan representatives, acting under formal delegation from Horano Benir who was needed on the home front as a civilian administrator.

On meeting with them, Cyriacus would create the following proposal:

[list=1]

[*]The Tribal Republic of Kuhaw-Astan ("Kuhaw-Astan") and the Committee of Executives of the Democratic Council (CEDC; "Democratic Astanir") jointly recognize the Argossian genocide that has transpired in Daesun-held territory and will endeavor, no matter the cost, to ensure that the perpatrators are brought to justice under any available international mechanisms.

[*]To safeguard against the joint tyranny of the Daesunic forces; the Restorationists; and the Isolationists, Kuhaw-Astan and Democratic Astanir will endeavor to form a united front against their enemies. 

[*]All extant military formations shall be reorganized and subsumed into a unified military command structure.

[*]Military strategy shall be coordinated by David Cyriacus, Horano Benir, Uuki-suk Makoli, and Ogjokam Alisan, who together shall form the Supreme Headquarters of the United Front.

[*]The political status of both Kuhaw-Astan and Democratic Astanir, their future bilateral ties, and other functions shall be decided at a conference that shall be done at a later time.
[/list]

[/spoiler]

[spoiler=Operation Haiyan, Luwakki Offensive]

[b]Operation Haiyan, Luwakki Offensive[/b]

After receiving drone reports of several platoon-sized Restorationist forces launching counteroffensives against 2nd and 5th Maneuver Armies, Gen. Bai He would decide to take initiative and immediately halt his offensive, instead order his small force to swing to the west to cut off the Restorationists from their supply lines.  At this same juncture, Lt. Gen. Erzhu's 6th Maneuver Army, which had been convalescing troops rotated out from Moran and Roylance's armies, would move into the former Tiansheng pocket to crush the Luwakki offensive from the front.

ZTZ-65 "Storm" tanks would take full advantage of drone reconaissance and Wuying-89 intel to rapidly charge down the Isolationists from all directions, while close-range Qianxun mortar teams and drone squadrons would work together to blunt the Isolationist approach with wave after wave of 82mm high explosive. 6th Maneuver Army, which was to face the offensive head-on, had initially considered digging in to defensive positions. However, following reports of the Isolationists' tactics combined with their own superior firepower would convince them that there was only one necessary course of action Attack!

Edwin Roylance, warned that his supply lines were potentially under threat, would too decide to momentarily stall his approach, ordering both Pax Int'l troops and popular committees to begin committing to a defense in depth to ensure that their salient could not be realistically threatened by Isolationist forces. PLZ-03 and PLZ-09 self-propelled howitzers would form [i]ad hoc[/i] batteries along these fortifications and hold steady in the mean time for what's to come.

[/spoiler]

[spoiler=Operation Haiyan, Race to the South]

[b]Operation Haiyan, Race to the South[/b]

With their overall strategic objectives immediately changed, 1st Maneuver Army would be left with two choices: Follow their initial objectives and maintain the charge, or stop as well and wait for the lines to stabilize. Freya Moran, unsure of the best course of action, would request the Astaniran popular committees to submit their own reports of the enemy's numbers, Pax International's own strengths, and their own personal courses of actions. After an hour, a general assessment of the battlefield was reached:

[list=1]

[*]The Astaniran National Forces had more manpower but inferior training, military equipment, morale, and supplies to Pax International forces.

[*]There appears to be no discernible evidence at this time that National forces intend to challenge the aerial superiority of Pax International forces, and has effectively surrendered its ability to prosecute conventional warfare.

[*]The National Navy is well-supplied and largely intact, but possessing aging task elements, with respectable lethal ranges but minimal aerial support. We have no evidence to suggest that they possess reliable at-sea replenishment. Until more can be understood about their capabilities, we surmise that the National Navy may only send out its task elements for five days at a time before needing to return to port.

[*]The Armed Restoration Front is currently pressed by Nordiheimian Armed Forces on land, sea, and air. Additionally, the Sanguinian Shamatine Assault Flotilla is due to arrive in good time. We remain confident that the Restorationists are unwilling or unable to mount their own offensive operations against Democratic territory.

[*]The ZTZ-65 has remained shockingly effective in Astanir, thanks largely to Pax Int'l aerial superiority, recent modernization efforts (particularly the adoption of the 105mm gun), proactive logistics, support from the popular committees, and the inability of the National Army to field appropriate anti-tank measures in the face of overwhelming firepower.

[*]First Maneuver Army has sustained very little casualties over the course of its initial offensive, and most battalions have expressed a willingness to continue their pursuit of what they widely perceive to be the retreating enemy.

[*]The CEDC has maintained that the Luwakki offensive is unlikely to strategically alter the course of Pax International's plans.

[*]There remains a persistent and permeable feeling among the men that victory seems to be near.

[/list]

With all these things taken into account, Moran would make the fateful decision to have 1st Maneuver Army continue its "Hail Mary" charge. At the advise of the SummitONE Board of Directors, Moran would split her massive army into eight tank companies and four infantry divisions and began a series of massive breakthroughs and encirclements of the National Army. To avoid a repeat of Roylance's case, 1st Maneuver Army would spread out over a wide line to avoid forming narrow, fragile salients for Isolationist forces to exploit, while commercially-made drones would remain ever-present throughout the Hail Mary, bombing fortifications and scouting out enemy positions for Pax Int'l assault guns.

As they drive harder and harder into National territory, Democratic Astaniran soldiers would be ordered to begin reappropriating land and industry en masse around occupied territory, restarting civilian operations and encouraging fleeing populations to return to their homes as residents of Democratic territory. Those that agree (or are forced) to join would be organized into popular committees to coordinate civil administration, though in the absence of willing collaborators SummitONE would not hesitate to recruit local warlords and gangs to run things on their behalf, with several being deputized to act as local police units.

A quick census would be made of the number of men that would be recruited from both these new popular committees and from the local Astaniran gangs, with Pax International hoping to have fielded enough Astaniran natives to begin rotating out some of its Vespurian and Qianxun elements, some of which had started to complain of overtime pay and constantly changing mission details, typically normal for most regular armed forces, but rather unusual for private military companies. MROS Dynamics, SummitONE's main rival, would be considered as a potential replacement for some of these disgruntled soldiers.

[/spoiler]

[spoiler=Battle of Yellow Bay]

[b]Battle of Yellow Bay[/b]

Realizing that the National Navy seems to be committed to expelling Pax International's naval presence out of the Astaniran area of responsibility, Admiral Yun Caibo would decide that now was the time for a total counterattack. With QNS Du Jiao, Tongyi, and Weizhu freshly resupplied at Kuangye Point, the Democratic Navy would begin its slow and steady advance south, keeping close tabs on Gen. Bai He's reports of the National Navy's movements and capabilities.

The hypothesized point of convergence between the two fleets would be at a stretch of coast known to the Qianxun provisionally as "Yellow Bay", differentiated from "Red Bay" where they first landed and "Green Bay" which was to be the intending assault point of the Sanguinian flotilla.

Du Jiao, the capital ship of Democratic naval forces, would be the absolute spear tip of Adm. Yun's advance, possessing powerful radars that could detect enemies up to 40 nautical miles or roughly 75 kilometers, utterly dwarfing the Astaniran National Navy's own capabilities. And so, as the two fleets slowly but surely make their approach to one another, Yun Caibo would ensure that at no point in time would their own ships be under threat by the National forces.

An hour later, the five Anlan-class missile boats would speed ahead ahead of the amphibious assault ships, forewarned by drone reconaissance, with the Du Jiao, Tongyi, and Weizhu immediately pulling back to avoid getting caught up in the engagements. Helicopters from these assault ships set off for the skies, equipped with dipping SONAR to detect submarines within 100 km of the fleet. However, it would be quickly realized that the National Navy had only sent a single submarine for its mission, and so focus would be quickly shifted to the cruisers now rapidly advancing on the surface.

In a brilliant flash, all five missile boats would unleash a powerful salvo of subsonic cruise missiles at the furthest possible effective range, followed through by the auxiliary missile craft accompanying the Democratic fleet. For the next few minutes, this would be all that Yun Caibo would allow his forces to commit, wary of a full-blown, oversaturating charge while the National Navy's capabilities were still uncertain to them.

[/spoiler]

[spoiler=The Shamatine Assault Flotilla]

[b]The Shamatine Assault Flotilla[/b]

Caio Graci would receive several warnings from both SummitONE and Nordiheimian intelligence to try and bypass the Restorationist island stronghold blocking their access to the Astaniran mainland. While debating the feasibility of such a risk maneuver, Graci's council would be interrupted by a second report, which now suggested that the Restorationists were being pressed heavily by the Nordiheimian Navy. Rejuvenated, the assault flotilla would continue its advance through the narrow Argos Strait, its men ready and waiting to join, then end the war once and for all.

Currently, the Assault Flotilla was at a stop at Nordiheim to refuel and resupply, with Caio Graci doubly serving as a diplomatic liasion to the Nordiheimians to coordinate diplomatic efforts, with Sanguivallis having been informed of recent events and plans to form a United Front. After a while though, the Flotilla would depart, continuing its long, half-circumnavigation of the world towards Astanir, the [i]Civitas Dei[/] slowly but surely coming into view on the horizon as a towering citadel, flanked evenly on all sides by its smaller, missile-equipped peers.

[/spoiler]

Behind the lines flew the P-8 Poseidon, Daesun's most prized naval warfare aircraft. Working in tandem with the Mugunghwa Shield and the E-2Ds, the Poseidon surveyed the ocean. [b]ANV KAKHARD IS ENTERED INTO MILITARY SERVICE[/b]
[i]East Shamatine West Time, District of Shiganuur[/i]
[i]The Alaqan Navy has given out the following information to the public[/i]

The testings off the coast of Issyk are completed. We do believe that the ANV Kakhard is indeed military grade and ready for service in combat environments.
